finlytic.example.subject: Finlytic's SOC 2 Type II, before the next enterprise review
finlytic.example.body:
Hi Rhea,

Saw that Finlytic's enterprise customers now want SOC 2 Type II before signing. Teams at your stage usually lose weeks to evidence collection.

Would a 20-minute walkthrough of how others got audit-ready in 90 days be useful?

Ekta

Hi Arjun,
